concerns.text: Functional Requirements reference undefined identifiers ‘US‑1’, ‘US‑2’, ‘US‑3’ (e.g., “(See US‑1)”). No user‑story IDs with this naming exist in the document; the stories are labeled ‘User Story 1’, ‘User Story 2’, etc. This breaks traceability and creates a dangling cross‑reference.

Success Criteria SC‑004 mentions reporting a global‑context activation proportion “≤ X %” for failure cases and “≥ Y %” for success cases, but the concrete values X and Y are never defined elsewhere in the spec, leaving the requirement underspecified.
